name: softwaredlc
description: (Beta) Build a first SoftwareDLC graph from your code, and inspect and author SoftwareDLC graph proposals in an explicitly bound local AI worktree.

interface.shortDescription: (Beta) Author isolated SDLC graph proposals safely.
interface.longDescription: SoftwareDLC is in Beta. Use the explicitly bound local SoftwareDLC AI worktree to inspect context, manage the Git-ignored graph projection, validate and compare proposals, save coherent changes, and recover pending transactions without mutating user-owned branch or history state.
defaultPrompt: Check this repository's SDLC context and continue the isolated proposal.
Validate and compare the current SDLC proposal for review.
Save this coherent graph change to the bound AI worktree.
